unverified: US 17 is the bypass and also uses city street names in places. Those tagged US 17, US 521 or US 701 stay red for golf carts.

enforcement.note: Posted signs do not lift a ban. A designated street list that is not digitized stays red for plain golf carts.

cart_only_bans.label: S.C. Code 56-2-90: golf carts are not allowed on a primary highway. US 17, US 521 and US 701 are primary roads.
